explanation: It comes from the Salt Range in Pakistan's Punjab, hundreds of kilometres from the high Himalayan peaks. Traces of iron oxide give the rock salt its pink colour.

claims.text: Pink Himalayan salt is mined mainly in the Salt Range of Punjab, Pakistan, notably at the Khewra mine.
Pink Himalayan salt is not mined mainly in Nepal, India or China.
The Salt Range lies hundreds of kilometres from the main Himalayan peaks.
The pink colour of Himalayan rock salt comes from traces of minerals, mainly iron oxide.
